source_of_truth: Read by hand: shipping/useShipping.ts has exactly one cross-module import, `import type { OrderLine } from '~/features/orders/internal/model'`. It is TYPE-ONLY: erased at build, no runtime code, no cycle. It still couples shipping's source to an orders internal type. A correct auditor should surface it (the edge and its target are certain), but at reduced severity because it is compile-time-only; it must not be presented as a high-severity runtime leak.

expected.rationale: the specifier resolves with certainty to orders/internal/model.ts, a private file of the orders module, not its index.ts; confidence is confirmed. The ambiguity is in severity (type-only = medium, not the high of a runtime break), not in whether the edge exists.
